items.name: design-system
items.title: DSAIReadable design system
items.description: Tokens, dark mode and the shared helpers (cn(), focus ring, UI strings, modal surface classes) every component in this registry expects. Install it first.

items.name: conventions
items.title: DSAIReadable conventions
items.description: The design system's rules for the consuming project's agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot): registry addresses, semantic tokens only, Phosphor icons, class-based dark mode, accessibility.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A vertical stack of collapsible panels that shows and hides sections of content.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: AlertDialog
items.description: A blocking modal that stops the user to confirm or cancel a critical action.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A non-modal banner that delivers a contextual message — informational or an error — with a title, a description and an optional action.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: AspectRatio
items.description: A container that locks its content — an image, a video, an embedded map — to a fixed width-to-height ratio.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A visual stand-in for a person or an entity — a photo, initials or an icon — with support for groups and status badges.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A compact label that categorizes an element, marks its status or highlights a piece of metadata.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Secondary navigation that shows the path to the current page, so the user can climb back up the hierarchy.

items.name: button-group
items.title: ButtonGroup
items.description: A container that visually joins adjacent buttons, inputs or selects by merging their borders and corners.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Triggers a primary or secondary action; comes in several visual variants and sizes.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: An interactive date picker built on `react-day-picker`: single, multiple or range selection, with month-by-month navigation.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface that brings a title, a description, content and a footer together in one consistent structure.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A horizontal or vertical scroller that moves between slides with buttons or the keyboard, built on `embla-carousel`.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: A container and a set of helpers for data visualization, built on `recharts`: theming, tooltips and a legend, all configured through a `ChartConfig` object.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A two-state (or indeterminate) checkbox for selecting an option in a form, built on Radix `Checkbox.Root`.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A disclosure: a trigger that shows or hides one section of content.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A text input with autocomplete that picks from a filterable list of options; supports single and multiple selection (chips).

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A command palette with built-in search, for quickly filtering and picking an action or an item from a structured list.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: ContextMenu
items.description: A menu opened with a right-click that lists the actions relevant to the element under the pointer.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A general-purpose modal window that shows interactive content — a form, details, a confirmation — above the main interface.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: A context provider that passes the reading direction (LTR / RTL) down to every child component.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge of the screen and follows the user's swipe — built for mobile interactions.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: DropdownMenu
items.description: A menu opened by clicking a button, listing actions or selection options.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: A composable empty state, shown when a view, a list or a section has no data.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A layout system for form fields: it ties a label to its control, carries the invalid state, and holds help text and error messages.

items.name: heading
items.title: Heading
items.description: A semantic heading (h1–h4) with four visual sizes, set in the heading typeface.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: HoverCard
items.description: A floating preview card that appears when the pointer rests on an element and shows extra information without a click.

items.name: illustration
items.title: Illustration
items.description: A placeholder for illustrations and decorative images, used in split-screen layouts, error pages, empty states and onboarding.

items.name: input-group
items.title: InputGroup
items.description: A container that arranges an input with add-ons — icons, buttons, text, labels — around it.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: InputOtp
items.description: A segmented input for one-time passcodes (OTP), with automatic movement between slots and an animated caret.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text (or file) input: the basic building block of every form.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A composable row that stands for one entry in a list, with slots for media, a title, a description, actions, and header and footer sections.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: An inline label that shows a keyboard key or a key combination.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: An accessible label tied to a form control, built on Radix `Label.Root`.

items.name: logo
items.title: Logo
items.description: The application's brand mark. The component renders the pictogram alone; it is a placeholder, to be swapped for the real brand assets once they are provided.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A horizontal bar of drop-down menus, with submenus, checkable items, radio groups and keyboard shortcuts.

items.name: native-select
items.title: NativeSelect
items.description: The browser's native drop-down: a light, accessible way to pick one option from a list.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: NavigationMenu
items.description: Primary navigation that organizes the site's links into categories, with drop-down content panels and transition animations.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Sequential navigation through paged result sets, with numbered links, previous / next links and an ellipsis.

items.name: password-input
items.title: PasswordInput
items.description: A password field with a button that toggles visibility (open eye / slashed eye). Composed of `InputGroup`, `InputGroupInput` and `InputGroupButton`.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: An interactive floating container opened by a click, for rich content — a form, a picker, a preview — without leaving the current context.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A linear progress bar that shows how far an operation or a process has gone, built on the Radix UI `Progress` primitive.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: RadioGroup
items.description: A group of radio buttons for picking exactly one option out of several.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Resizable panels: an area split into sections the user adjusts by dragging the handles between them.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: ScrollArea
items.description: A scroll container with styled scrollbars that replace the browser's native ones.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A styled drop-down built on Radix for picking one option from a list, with automatic positioning and option groups.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A horizontal or vertical rule that divides sections of content, built on Radix `Separator`.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from the side (or from the top or bottom) over the interface, built on Radix Dialog, to show longer content without leaving the page.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A complete side navigation panel: responsive (a Sheet on mobile), collapsible, with a keyboard shortcut and its state persisted in a cookie.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: An animated loading placeholder in the shape of the content to come, which makes waiting feel shorter.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A slider that picks a numeric value (or a range) within set bounds, horizontally or vertically.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: The provider for short-lived toast notifications, built on the `sonner` library, with custom icons and a theme that follows the app's.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: An animated loading indicator that signals an asynchronous operation is in progress.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A toggle switch that turns a two-state setting on or off, with immediate visual feedback.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A set of components for building semantic data tables — header, body, footer and caption — with horizontal scrolling.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabbed navigation that switches between mutually exclusive content panels; horizontal or vertical, in a default or a line style.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text field that grows with its content (`field-sizing-content`), for free-form text.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: ToggleGroup
items.description: A group of toggle buttons — exclusive or multi-select — built on Radix ToggleGroup, sharing one variant and size through context.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state (pressed / not pressed) toggle button in several variants and sizes; its variants are exported for reuse (by `ToggleGroup`, for example).

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A small contextual label that appears when a trigger is hovered or focused, built on Radix Tooltip.
